tasks.title: Essay: Evaluating Priorities for Bus Service Improvements
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.text: In your English class you have been discussing how to improve bus services in your region. Now your English teacher has asked you to write an essay.
Write an essay using all the notes and giving reasons for your point of view.

tasks.title: Review: A Regional Bus Improvement Plan
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.heading: Reviews wanted
paragraphs: A regional bus improvement plan has been proposed for our area. Have you seen the plan or heard about it? Write a review of the plan for our magazine.
Explain what the plan aims to do, say whether you think it will be effective, and recommend one change you would make to improve it.
The best reviews will be published in the next issue.

tasks.title: Article: Bus Plan – What Does It Mean for Us?
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted
paragraphs: Bus plan: what does it mean for us?
Our region is planning to improve bus services. Write an article for our website explaining how the plan could affect young people in the area.
Describe one possible benefit and one possible drawback, and suggest what young people should do to make their voices heard.
We will publish the best articles on our website.

tasks.title: Email: Bus Plan in Your Area
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.subject: Bus plan in your area
paragraphs: I heard that your region is planning to improve bus services. What do you think about the plan? Do you support it or not? Also, how will it affect your daily life? I'm curious about what changes you'd like to see.

designReview.specificSetting: a regional bus improvement plan planning brief 27

tasks.scenario: Essay discussing priorities for improving bus services in the region
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Unique essay topic on bus improvement; not a reused skeleton. Notes panel with two supplied points plus own idea.

tasks.scenario: Review of a proposed regional bus improvement plan
requiredContentPoints: what the plan aims to do
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Review of a plan, not a facility or event; different from previous review tasks.

tasks.scenario: Article explaining how the bus plan could affect young people
requiredContentPoints: suggest how young people can make their voices heard
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Article focused on impact on youth; not a generic 'how to improve' article.

tasks.scenario: Email to a friend about the bus plan
tasks.purpose: explain a position and request arrangements
requiredContentPoints: how it will affect daily life
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Email about a local transport plan; different from previous email tasks (e.g., holiday, course advice).

designReview.overallOriginalityCheck: All tasks are based on the same concrete scenario (regional bus improvement plan) but each has a distinct genre, audience, and content points. No reuse of skeletons from previous tests. No forbidden concepts detected.
